author: P.L.S.Müller, 1776
status: 겨울철새, 해마다 수천 마리 · 여름에도 드물게 기록(10건 미만)
habitat: 논, 율무밭, 옥수수밭, 얼어붙은 저수지, 강 모래톱

months.note: 2~3월에 암수가 마주 보고 우는 구애 행동을 볼 수 있다.

summary: 해마다 수천 마리가 찾아오는 겨울철새로, 국내에서는 강원도 철원과 경기도 연천, 파주, 강화 등 주로 비무장지대와 민간인통제지역 일대에서 겨울을 난다. 월동지에서는 논, 율무밭, 옥수수밭에서 먹이를 찾고, 얼어붙은 저수지나 강의 모래톱을 잠자리로 쓴다. 암수와 그 새끼로 이루어진 가족 단위로 움직이며, 2~3월에는 암수가 마주 서서 부리를 하늘로 든 채 되풀이해 우는 구애 행동을 볼 수 있다. 러시아 동남부 한카호, 중국 동북 지방, 일본 홋카이도, 몽골 동부 등지에서 번식하고 한국과 중국 동남부에서 월동한다.
young: 어린새는 몸이 희고 머리와 목은 연한 갈색이다.

art.subject: Red-crowned Crane (Grus japonensis), adult, as seen in Korean winter fields from November to March: body and wings white; a patch of bare red skin on the crown; forehead, lores, cheeks, throat and the front and sides of the upper neck black; a broad white band runs from behind the eye across the nape and down the back of the neck; lower neck white. Secondaries and long, drooping tertials black, forming a black bustle over the white tail when the wings are folded; primaries white. Bill long, pale greenish-horn to yellowish-green. Legs and feet black.
art.pose: walking slowly through a harvested rice field
art.scene: Korean winter rice and corn fields in a remote border area, with a frozen reservoir and river sandbars; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view standing: white body, red crown, black lores, cheeks, throat and foreneck, white band from behind the eye down the hindneck, drooping black tertials over the white tail, yellowish-green bill, black legs
juvenile (first winter), side view standing: white body mottled grey-brown, head and neck pale cinnamon-brown, no red crown, blackish tertials, dark legs
art.build: Very large crane, about 140cm, the largest crane in Korea and much taller than a Grey Heron. Long, slender neck held upright; small head; bill straight, about as long as the head or a little longer. Legs very long and black. At rest the black secondaries and drooping tertials hang over the short white tail and look like a black tail. In flight the neck is stretched forward and the legs trail; the wings are white with black secondaries forming a black rear edge to the inner wing, the primaries white.
avoid: Do not paint black primaries or a black tail; the black on the folded wing is the drooping tertials and secondaries only.
Do not paint red skin around the eye or pink legs (White-naped Crane).
Do not paint a white throat or white foreneck; the throat and upper foreneck are black.
Do not paint a grey body (White-naped or Common Crane).
